item.title: Putin says there are points he can’t agree to in the US proposal to end Russia’s war in Ukraine
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin says some proposals in a U.S. plan to end the war in Ukraine are unacceptable to the Kremlin, indicating in comments published Thursday that any deal is still some ways off.

item.title: Garber doesn’t rule out relegation in MLS but makes clear it’s years or decades away
item.description: Major League Soccer Commissioner Don Garber won't rule out adopting relegation and promotion while making clear such a decision is years or decades away.

item.title: Zohran Mamdani and the Louvre make the list of most mispronounced words of 2025
item.description: From the election of Zohran Mamdani to the intrigue surrounding the jewel heist at the Louvre, keeping up with this year's news also left some Americans struggling with pronunciations. That's put both the name of New York City's incoming mayor and the famed Paris museum on a list of the most mispronounced words in 2025.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis release mariners held since July ship attack
item.description: Yemen’s Houthi rebels on Wednesday released 11 mariners held since a July attack on the ship Eternity C in the Red Sea, an assault that killed four on board and sank the vessel.
